question: Can restricted pure-relation/proxy information be represented in centered CRPS matrices and all adaptive posterior branches retained, giving correct and less costly two-step evaluation?
candidate_increment: A clearly scoped reusable centered-CDF kernel for finite uncertain dependencies, a sufficiency boundary/counterexample, and implementation that may reduce repeated integration while preserving adaptive branch decisions. Novelty and practical speed not yet established.
must_preserve: full posterior outcome branches for adaptive second action
common proxy marginal and factorization assumptions
equal posterior/action/cost and optimized cached-vectorized baseline
same-rho separable and dense/loose-bound negative controls
no changed tolerance after seeing failures
allowed: Mathematical product; small clean synthetic prototype after its exact plan/source freezes and independent approval; no real material fitting or label reveals
forbidden: old pilot tuning/refit/resplit; treating fixedpair trace as adaptive sufficient state; claiming pure E learns theta; fabricated material-specific rho/costs; topconference readiness
closed_loop_limit: Pure proxy E has theta-independent marginal; actual reciprocal feedback requires paid target V/co-measurement. Two-action kernel is a submechanism, not completed generative hypercycle agent.
new_material_gate: Only after this control is auditable and actual data assumptions/feature mapping are separately admitted; metadata availability is not response validity.
